headline: The U.C.L.A. Bollywood Dance Team That Inspired ‘Best of the Best’
context: “For a lot of South Asians, dance is the way we connect,” said a member of the U.C.L.A. team Nashaa. Our photographer captured glimpses of the team last year, from audition to competitions.
